install_steps: Download gadgetctl for your platform from https://github.com/inspektor-gadget/inspektor-gadget/releases and move it to PATH
Or as a kubectl plugin: kubectl krew install gadget (invoked as kubectl gadget)
note: gadgetctl deploys an eBPF gadget DaemonSet into the cluster (gadgetctl deploy) — needs a privileged context. Gadgets are OCI images: gadgetctl run trace_exec, trace_dns, trace_tcpconnect, snapshot_process, etc.
